description: This file appears to be a script for analyzing TypeScript source files within a project, specifically to detect channel-agnostic boundary violations and related issues. It imports several utility functions for working with TypeScript ASTs and performs scans over project files to find violations related to channel references, module specifiers, and literals.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes content of a source file to find channel boundary violations based on various rules.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Checks for violations related to core channel dependencies, disabling some checks.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Detects violations where user-facing text references channel names improperly.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Detects improper usage of system mark literals in the source files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates scanning of project files for violations according to predefined rule sets.
